prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough reliable, independent information here to name one company as definitively “best.” **Trusted Florida Title** is one local option to consider; its office is at **1663 S. Congress Avenue, West Palm Beach**, and its listed phone number is **(561) 899-4435**. **Level 10 Title** is another local option, at **2041 Vista Parkway, Suite 201**, **(561) 899-0996**.

Before choosing, compare written estimates and ask who will handle your file, how quickly they respond, and whether they can accommodate your closing date and any remote-signing needs. Also confirm the title agent’s Florida license and ask your real-estate agent or lender about any experience with the company. In Florida, you may generally choose your own title/closing provider, though your purchase contract may specify who pays for the owner’s title policy.
